name: Set up native Swift validation
description: Install the pinned Swift toolchain and native validation prerequisites.

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
      with:
        python-version: '3.12'
    - name: Install Ubuntu build and validation dependencies
      if: runner.os == 'Linux'
      shell: bash
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends \
          binutils ca-certificates clang curl git gnupg2 libc6-dev \
          libcurl4-openssl-dev libedit2 libgcc-13-dev libncurses-dev \
          libpython3-dev libsqlite3-0 libstdc++-13-dev libxml2-dev \
          libz3-dev pkg-config python3 tzdata unzip zlib1g-dev
    - name: Import Swift signing keys before verifying the Swiftly installer
      if: runner.os == 'Linux'
      shell: bash
      run: |
        # setup-swift v3 verifies Swiftly before it imports any signing keys.
        # Decode compressed responses as in Swift's official signing guide.
        curl --compressed --fail --show-error --silent --location --retry 3 \
          --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/swift-signing-keys.asc" https://www.swift.org/keys/all-keys.asc
        gpg --batch --import "$RUNNER_TEMP/swift-signing-keys.asc"
        gpg --batch --list-keys E813C892820A6FA13755B268F167DF1ACF9CE069
    - uses: swift-actions/setup-swift@v3
      if: runner.os != 'Windows'
      with:
        swift-version: '6.4.1'
        skip-verify-signature: false
    - name: Enable Windows developer mode and require native build prerequisites
      if: runner.os == 'Windows'
      shell: pwsh
      run: |
        New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem' -Name LongPathsEnabled -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force
        New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\AppModelUnlock' -Force | Out-Null
        New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\AppModelUnlock' -Name AllowDevelopmentWithoutDevLicense -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force
        $vswhere = "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe"
        $installation = & $vswhere -latest -products '*' -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $installation) { throw 'MSVC x64 build tools are required' }
        $sdk = Get-ChildItem "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Windows Kits\10\Include" -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^10\.0\.\d+\.0$' -and [version]$_.Name -ge [version]'10.0.22000.0' }
        if (-not $sdk) { throw 'Windows SDK 10.0.22000 or newer is required' }
    - name: Install Swift 6.4.1 on Windows
      if: runner.os == 'Windows'
      uses: compnerd/gha-setup-swift@9ff1ee4c44888c5817fc14d1b257ac8cabb4935f # v0.5.1
      with:
        swift-version: swift-6.4.1-release
        swift-build: 6.4.1-RELEASE
        build_arch: amd64
    - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
      with:
        node-version: '24'

scope: Read-only source facts from the selected implementation base; no dependency resolution, native build or hosted run.
